purpose: Make the original Russ 2021 article, its two published author corrections, the pinned Supplementary Table 1 receipt, and the adult-lumbar validation context reviewable together before any narrower label-transfer proposal.

sourceArticle.currentArticleNotice: The publisher page identifies author corrections published on 2022-02-18 and 2022-10-19.
sourceArticle.scope: Postnatal harmonized transcriptomic reference. The adult-lumbar in situ hybridization validation context is a separate condition and not an individual-cell coordinate space.

pinnedMarkerTable.title: Supplementary Table 1: harmonized cell type markers
pinnedMarkerTable.boundary: No correction record reviewed here states that Supplementary Table 1 marker values or labels were changed. That absence is not proof of a one-to-one biological identity.

corrections.scope: HTML supplementary-table links and incorrect cross-references to Supplementary Tables 2, 5, 7, and 8.
corrections.directEffectOnPinnedMarkerTable: No Table 1 content or label change is stated by this correction.
corrections.crosswalkDecision: Keep the marker-table receipt; record that the correction exists and do not treat a corrected table reference as a new molecular mapping.

corrections.scope: Figure 3A label correction: duplicated Excit-21 replaced by Excit-31 and omitted Excit-32 restored on the right side of the panel.
corrections.directEffectOnPinnedMarkerTable: No Table 1 content or label change is stated by this correction.
corrections.crosswalkDecision: Treat Figure 3A as a corrected visual annotation; do not infer an exact prototype identity from its labels.

reconciliationItems.evidence: A source URL, byte count, and SHA-256 lock the reviewed Supplementary Table 1 object; the two published corrections state no Table 1 content or label change.
reconciliationItems.curatorQuestion: Does the package retain the exact receipt and clearly distinguish a correction to table references from a change to Table 1 contents?
reconciliationItems.notEstablished: The receipt does not establish a complete marker rule, exact biological identity, age-specific presence, or coordinate.

reconciliationItems.evidence: The article describes a postnatal harmonized reference and adult-lumbar in situ validation; the article cautions that some adult-lumbar expression patterns differ from the harmonized sequencing data.
reconciliationItems.curatorQuestion: Are postnatal transcriptomic labels and adult-lumbar validation kept as separate evidence contexts in every display and export?
reconciliationItems.notEstablished: Neither context supplies an individual-cell atlas coordinate, a same-cell multiomic link, or a transfer to a project entity.

reconciliationItems.evidence: The 2022-10 author correction identifies the Figure 3A Excit-21/Excit-31/Excit-32 label issue and says the PDF and HTML were corrected.
reconciliationItems.curatorQuestion: Does the explorer retain this correction without claiming that the figure establishes a project-specific V3, V2a, or SC^Vsx2::Hoxa10 identity?
reconciliationItems.notEstablished: A corrected figure label is not a cell coordinate, adult segment assignment, circuit edge, or registration.

releaseDecision.permitted: Display the source receipts, correction records, and explicit type-level uncertainty alongside the non-exact crosswalk.
releaseDecision.forbidden: Do not change a prototype mapping to exact, add an atlas coordinate, infer a connection, merge adult and postnatal contexts, or create REG.
releaseDecision.nextCuratorGate: A curator must record a source-version, evidence-context, target-vocabulary, and explicit rejection condition before any future narrower molecular transfer is proposed.
